title: Geophysics MicroseismicBrief

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed microseismic analysis brief. Conducted comprehensive analysis of station geometry and arrival time data, identified three distinct spatial clusters with highly regular temporal patterns (mean interval = 0.499 s, CV = 0.055). Generated 4 key figures and produced a detailed research report with methodology, results, interpretation, and recommendations. All deliverables are complete: analysis code in code/, intermediate results in outputs/, and final report in report/report.md with figures in report/images/.
